guitar.notes: John Denver was known for playing Guild acoustics (D-40, F-50) live and on recordings.

tone.target: warm steel-string acoustic folk strum, dry and close-mic
tone.profile: warm steel-string acoustic folk strum, dry and close-mic
tone.summary: The rig simulates a warm, dry acoustic folk sound using clean preamps and an appropriate cab, focusing on natural strumming dynamics.
corrections: acoustic sim or piezo model only

rig.name: John Denver - Take Me Home, Country Roads - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain a tight signal.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for clean tones.

blocks.purpose: Even out the dynamics of acoustic strumming and enhance pick attack.
blocks.gap: The Comp module is used to simulate the natural, consistent volume of a close-mic'd acoustic guitar. No dedicated Acoustic Preamp model exists in the catalog.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No distortion or gain is required for the clean folk tone.
Provide a clean, warm foundation suitable for acoustic strumming.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen as the cleanest and most versatile amp simulation available, mimicking a classic non-aggressive soundboard setup.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a close-mic'd, dry studio recording environment.
blocks.gap: The US 2x12 is the most appropriate cabinet for simulating a focused, non-aggressive acoustic sound. A dedicated Acoustic IR would be ideal.

blocks.purpose: Slightly boost the fundamental frequencies (bass and treble) to enhance the warmth and clarity of the strum.
blocks.gap: Used for fine-tuning the acoustic tone, compensating for missing dedicated EQ controls on an acoustic model.

blocks.purpose: Bypass. No filtering or wah effect is needed for this dry folk tone.
Bypass. Modulation (Chorus, Tremolo) and Delay/Reverb were explicitly avoided.
Bypass. Reverb was explicitly avoided to maintain a dry, close-mic sound.

improvements.summary: Replace the generic cabinet simulation with an IR designed for close-mic'd acoustic instruments to enhance realism.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Close-Mic Acoustic Guitar IR (e.g., Neumann U47 or specific DI/Studio Mic)
proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too generic for a dry, close-mic acoustic sound.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased realism and clarity in the fundamental frequencies.
